name: catalog-placement-multitouch
description: MOBILE-3: a second finger's independent pointer stream must not hijack an in-progress catalog placement drag (the same BUG-1/MOBILE-1/MOBILE-2 class already fixed for furniture drag, gizmos, and marquee-select). Arms a catalog placement (as a long-press would), grabs it with pointerId 9 (mirroring the finger that would have long-pressed the card), drives the ghost with a real pointermove, then asserts a second pointer (id 202) moving/lifting on the canvas is completely ignored: the ghost cursor follows ONLY pointer 9, a second finger's lift neither commits nor cancels the placement, and only pointer 9's lift commits it.
